messages:
Maya: Heads-up — BetaCorp renewal meeting next Tue. want to run a short preflight (15m) focused on demo reliability, latency spikes, and the customer-facing fallback story. I put together a tiny runbook below we can follow in the call.

Ethan: SGTM. Can we include a checklist for pre-demo warm-up (cache priming + sample prompts) and a quick way to reproduce a reported 800ms tail in their logs?

Sam: Quick SRE triage snippet to run during preflight:
```bash
# check serving latency for model pinned to v1.2
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"open-vicuna-13b","input":"ping"}' | jq '.latency_ms'
# tail recent pod logs and grep for KV cache misses
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/runner --since=10m | grep -i "kv-cache-miss" | tail -n 20
```
Also watch the per-route token breakdown in Console (left nav -> telemetry) to see batching-impacted paths.

Maya: Runbook for the 15m preflight (copy into calendar invite):
1) Intro (1m) — align on success criteria for the demo.
2) Warmup (4m) — trigger 10 sample requests across the 3 most-used prompt shapes (see sample set A).
3) Health checks (4m) — run Ethan/Sam commands, confirm avg p50 and p95 and KV cache hit% > 70%.
4) Fallback walkthrough (3m) — show canary -> fallback to smaller model and explain quality tradeoffs.
5) Feedback capture & next steps (3m) — confirm followups and who owns action items.

Ethan: Sample prompt set (short):
- A: "Summarize the following email in one sentence: ..."
- B: "Rewrite for tone=legal: ..."
- C: "Generate 3 subject lines for: ..."
We should include tokens-per-response expectations so CS can call out cost impact during the renewal convo.

Priya: Thanks — I can join Tue 10:30am PT. Also can you add a quick customer-facing note about what to expect if we fail over to the fallback model? BetaCorp cares about deterministic answers.

Maya: @Priya added. Quick script we can paste into the demo notes: "If we detect high latency or degraded quality, we'll switch to a smaller, lower-latency model variant. This preserves availability but may reduce phrasing fidelity; we'll flag any quality regressions in post-call follow-up and provide a recommended prompt tweak."

Sam: Ops tips for the call: keep the Console open to the model dashboard, have the canary toggle ready (show toggling in UI), and set temporary increased logging for that tenant for 30m after the call (use label tenant=betacorp).

ci-bot: [deploybot] BetaCorp canary rollout status: last deploy 2026-03-10T09:12:03Z, success. No recent incidents.

Maya: Action items: Ethan — prep sample prompts + token estimates. Sam — provide the kubectl commands and a one-liner to set tenant-level logging. I will update the calendar invite with the runbook and the short customer note. Priya — will invite BetaCorp AMs. :thumbsup:

Ethan: Done — uploaded sample set to the shared doc. link: https://docs.redwood.example/s/abc123

Priya: Got it — thanks everyone. See you Tue.
